why_summary: Practical platform engineering and AI inference. Skip vendor pitches. Leave room for breaks.

Get better at Kubernetes incident response when the hard part is missing context, not more dashboards.

platform engineers operating inference on Kubernetes
breaks: A real lunch away from sessions, and no third talk in a morning block.
